The appointments bring the team strength to seven people in total.

Robeco has made three appointments to its private debt team.

Arthur Staal, Bunyod Obidkhonov (pictured left) and Vicente Esteve Cuevas (pictured right) will start on 1 January 2027. All will have the role of senior loan manager and be based in Rotterdam.

With these additions, the firm’s private debt team will grow from four to seven loan managers and work closely with the firm’s broader credit platform of more than 40 credit managers and 50 sustainability specialists.

Robeco said the expansion of the team follows “significant institutional client commitments”.

The firm added it is seeing strong demand from pension funds and insurers for private debt as a source of additional income and portfolio diversification.

Anton Eser, chief investment officer, said: “Expanding our private debt capabilities further strengthens our investment platform and reflects our commitment to providing innovative, high-quality investment solutions.

“The addition of this highly experienced team enhances our ability to address evolving client needs and reinforces our position as a leading active investment manager across both public and private markets.”

Erik van Leeuwen, head of fundamental fixed income, added: “We are delighted to welcome this highly experienced team to Robeco.

“Their expertise is complementary to our existing private debt capabilities and further strengthens our ability to meet growing client demand for customised private debt solutions.”
